title: Kassio — POS & Inventory

title: Maligaya Taxi Platform
description: A connected taxi booking and operations platform for passengers, drivers, dispatchers, and management—with live trip visibility, safety controls, and an interactive multi-app simulation.

title: FuelSuite
description: An offline-first gas station operations platform that brings shifts, pumps, cash, inventory, customer credit, and reporting into one dependable desktop experience.
